title: Advanced Wildfire Containment Strategy
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates an advanced wildfire containment strategy game on a grid-based terrain with a scoring system.

## Scene Setup
- Create a 20x20 grid of tiles on the XZ plane. Each tile is a 1x1 BoxGeometry with height 0.15.
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 25, 20) looking at the grid center (10, 0, 10).
- Lights: One DirectionalLight from (10, 20, 10) with intensity 1.0, plus AmbientLight intensity 0.4.
- Tile types by color:
  - GRASS (green #228B22): burnable, default state
  - FIRE (orange-red #FF4500): actively burning
  - BURNED (dark gray #333333): already consumed
  - FIREBREAK (sandy brown #C2B280): player-placed containment line, non-burnable
  - WATER (blue #1E90FF): player-placed water drop, extinguishes fire and prevents reignition

## Initial State
- All tiles start as GRASS.
- Place 3 initial fire sources at grid positions (5,5), (14,3), and (10,15).
- The simulation starts PAUSED.

## Fire Spread Physics
- Fire spreads to adjacent (4-directional, not diagonal) GRASS tiles.
- Each burning tile has a burn timer. After 3 spread ticks, a FIRE tile becomes BURNED.
- Fire spread rate: every 500ms (one tick), each FIRE tile has a 40% chance to ignite each adjacent GRASS tile.
- Fire CANNOT spread to FIREBREAK or WATER tiles.
- Wind direction: default is 'north' (negative Z). Tiles in the wind direction have 70% ignition chance instead of 40%.

## User Interactions
- Mouse: Raycaster-based tile selection. Hovering highlights the tile with emissive color. Clicking places the currently selected tool.
- Tools (switch via keyboard):
  - Press '1': Select FIREBREAK tool (costs 5 points per tile)
  - Press '2': Select WATER tool (costs 15 points per tile, extinguishes fire if placed on FIRE tile)
- Press SPACE to toggle simulation pause/resume.
- Press 'W' to cycle wind direction: north -> east -> south -> west -> north.
- Press 'R' to reset the entire simulation to initial state.

## Scoring System
- Player starts with 200 resource points.
- Score starts at 0.
- Every tick, score += (number of GRASS tiles still alive) * 0.1
- Placing tools costs resource points. If insufficient points, placement fails.
- Bonus: +50 points if fire is fully contained (no FIRE tiles remain and at least 50% of tiles are still GRASS).
- Final score displayed when all fire is out (no FIRE tiles) or all GRASS is consumed.

## HUD / DOM Elements
- Top-left overlay div with id='hud' showing:
  - Current tool (id='currentTool')
  - Resource points (id='resources')
  - Score (id='score')
  - Wind direction (id='windDir')
  - Simulation status paused/running (id='simStatus')
  - Tick count (id='tickCount')
  - Tiles on fire count (id='fireCount')
  - Grass tiles remaining (id='grassCount')
- A 'Reset' button with id='resetBtn'.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- grid: 2D array [row][col] with tile type strings ('GRASS','FIRE','BURNED','FIREBREAK','WATER')
- paused: boolean
- score: number
- resources: number
- currentTool: string ('FIREBREAK' or 'WATER')
- windDirection: string ('north','east','south','west')
- tickCount: number
- fireCount: number (current FIRE tiles)
- grassCount: number (current GRASS tiles)
- burnedCount: number
- firebreakCount: number
- waterCount: number
- containmentBonus: boolean (true if bonus was awarded)
- gameOver: boolean
- totalTiles: 400

Update __3D_STATE__ every tick and after every user action.
physics_constraints: Fire spreads only to 4-directional adjacent GRASS tiles. Wind direction increases spread probability in that direction from 40% to 70%. FIREBREAK and WATER tiles block fire spread. Burn timer of 3 ticks converts FIRE to BURNED. Tile counts must always sum to totalTiles (400). Resources cannot go below 0. Score is monotonically non-decreasing until game over.
